usedFor: Wordpress holds the site's posts and users, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Created” in Wordpress, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new site user is a clear event to run a command on your computers.

watchOut: “Post Updated” in Wordpress fires on updates, so the same post can run the command repeatedly.
